fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: UnknownStateFilters
fields.about: Set of state filters provided in the request which were unknown to the transaction coordinator.

fields.name: TransactionStates
fields.about: The current state of the transaction for the transactional id.

fields.name: TransactionState
fields.about: The current transaction state of the producer.
